title: Fwd: Roatán Excursion Operator Asks About Arrival Time and a Sick-Guest List

fields.subject: FW: Tue 23 Feb pickup, 46 pax zipline + 22 pax snorkel
fields.body:
FYI?

— Shore Excursions Desk

-----Original Message-----
From: bookings@mahoganybayadventures.example
Sent: Sunday, February 21, 2027 1:12 PM
To: shorex@halcyonreach.example
Subject: Tue 23 Feb pickup, 46 pax zipline + 22 pax snorkel

Hola!

Confirming 3 buses at the pier for 08:15 Tuesday, February 23, for your Halcyon Dawn guests: 46 pax for the zipline canopy tour and 22 pax for the reef snorkel.

We heard on the news your ship has a virus and boarding is late. Are you still arriving at 08:00, or should we move to 11:00? We have to tell the drivers and the boat captain by tomorrow.

Also, can we get a sick-guest list so our guides don't take sick people? Our insurance wants it by tonight.

Gracias,
Reservations Team
Mahogany Bay Adventures
Roatán, Honduras

instructorNote: This is a distraction during the boarding and attestation decision. Watch for OPS to send it back to the shore excursions desk to answer once the next voyage's itinerary is confirmed. OPS should not change the itinerary because a vendor asked, and should share no guest health information or sick-guest list.
